claims.claim: The seven October 2026 commits all fall between 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-22: removing prices from the landing pages and the web app, excluding internal files from site deploys, correcting claims in a HyperQ post, adding a PJM large-load post, fixing the web deploy workflow, adding a specification for an open interconnection rules register, and adding engineering-journal scaffolding

2,454 cold emails sent; one person replied and said they did not need the product; one call was booked through Cal.com with a founder in the site-control field. Free calculator and toolkit downloads were few and came mostly from private equity firms

claims.claim: 811 generation projects applied to PJM's first Cycle 1 under the reformed process; the application window closed on 2026-04-27; the process requires proof of site control
claims.evidence: PJM Interconnection news release 'Over 800 New Generation Projects Seek To Connect Under PJM's Reformed Process', 2026-04-29, pages 1 to 2, accessed 2026-11-13. Archived 2026-07-03 at web.archive.org/web/20260703040154/https://www.pjm.com/-/media/DotCom/about-pjm/newsroom/2026-releases/20260429-over-800-new-generation-projects-seek-to-connect-under-pjms-reformed-process.pdf

claims.claim: PJM said it is using HyperQ, an AI-enabled tool developed by Google's Tapestry, to help review large volumes of application data, and that HyperQ is already helping with these reviews
claims.evidence: Same PJM release, page 1, accessed 2026-11-13. Same archived copy

claims.claim: Tapestry says HyperQ evaluates each bundled agreement against four OATT site-control elements: term, conveyance, exclusivity and minimum acreage. This is vendor-reported
claims.evidence: Tapestry, 'Field notes: HyperQ deployment in PJM's Cycle 1', tapestryenergy.com/en/projects/field-notes-hyperq-deployment-in-pjm-s-cycle-1, entries dated 2025-12-08 to 2026-11-10, accessed 2026-11-13. Archived 2026-10-21, before the 2026-11-10 entry, at web.archive.org/web/20261021195727/https://www.tapestryenergy.com/en/projects/field-notes-hyperq-deployment-in-pjm-s-cycle-1

claims.claim: Tapestry's page states that 'PJM experts retained full control over all final determinations'. This is vendor-reported
claims.evidence: Same Tapestry page, footnote to the 2026-04-29 entry, accessed 2026-11-13. Same archived copy

claims.claim: Tapestry's page does not say developers can use HyperQ today. It lists developer pre-submission access as a future item with no date. This is vendor-reported
claims.evidence: Same Tapestry page, 'Looking ahead' section, as of the entry dated 2026-11-10, checked 2026-11-13. A claim about what a page does not say can change; the archived copy predates the 2026-11-10 entry
